proposal:
AUDIT (code read; nothing executed). Compression and core soundness stand as written: _verify_certificate rebuilds blocks from every dense clause; probe() only deletes clauses and answers UNSAT only through verified compression plus 2-SAT. Two total-work defects. (a) step() is memoised on the raw restrict() tuple, but refute() runs on canon_plus output, so distinct raw states with one canonical form repeat IALH. This is consistent with the measured 4/12 identical calls; memoise refute on `reduced`. (b) attempt() canonicalises all non-tautological pos×neg resolvents before testing admissibility, and canon's subsumption is quadratic. At the 512-clause cap a 256×256 trial is about 4·10^9 subset tests per rejected variable.

CLASSIFICATION. In the Neon58 quotient the positive clauses P are the CNF of f=(∧A_i)∨(∧B_j), A_i=a_i∨a_i'. Its minimal transversals are exactly the 32 pair-selections, so N=Tr(P). The residual is an instance of monotone hypergraph duality (DUAL).

DEFINITIONS. A CNF is split if every clause is all-positive or all-negative (families P, N). It is cross-intersecting if every p∈P shares a variable with every n∈N.
Lemma 0 (elementary). For cross-intersecting split F: F is UNSAT iff min(N)=Tr(P). So SAT on this class and DUAL are interreducible by identity maps plus subsumption.

MECHANISM FK-SPLIT (not implemented; runs after exact compression).
S1 Polarity. Find flips making every clause monochromatic: each clause imposes flip(u)⊕flip(v)=[signs differ]. Parity union-find, O(L·α(L)) for L literal occurrences. Components are solved separately; inside one the colouring is unique up to a global swap. The 20-variable Neon58 input fails S1: clauses [-1,-3,-7,-13,14] and [-1,-3,-7,13,-14] demand flip1=flip13 and flip1≠flip13. Its quotient passes with zero flips, so compression must precede S1.
S2 Defect saturation. For n∈N let D(n)={p∈P: p∩n=∅}. Replace ¬n by {¬(n∪t): t∈Tr(D(n))}. Lemma 1: the models are unchanged, because under P every p∈D(n) has a true variable, and the result is cross-intersecting. Cost ≤ m·w^δ clauses, δ=max|D(n)|; a symmetric P-side version exists.
S3 Recursion on canonical (unit propagation + subsumption) states. If Σ_C 2^(-|C|)<1, return SAT by conditional expectations. Otherwise some clause C has |C|≤log₂m, and by cross-intersection some x∈C lies in at least a 1/log₂m fraction of the opposite family. Branch on x: one child deletes that fraction of the opposite family, the other deletes C. Cross-intersection is hereditary under restriction, so v=|P|·|N| obeys T(v)≤T((1−1/log₂m)v)+T(v−1)+1.
Theorem A (Fredman–Khachiyan 1996, Algorithm A; rederived above, not Lean-checked). S3 decides every cross-intersecting split CNF, SAT or UNSAT, in m^O(log²m) nodes. Each node costs O(m²w) for canon plus O(nm(w+log m)) dyadic bit operations. Memoisation only lowers the count. The certificate is the branching tree with unit-refutable or witnessed leaves.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT GIVE. By Lemma 0, a polynomial bound on this class is exactly DUAL∈P, open since 1996. Polynomial work for every transversal-type residual therefore cannot come from another detector. For arbitrary CNF, S1 fails on one mixed clause. Duplicating variables restores a split form but makes δ equal to the number of clauses avoiding a variable, so S2 is exponential. The honest parameterised form is work ≤ 2^β·(m·w^δ)^O(log²m), with β a branching backdoor to split form. Neither β nor δ is bounded, and minimising β is NP-hard.

CALIBRATION. T_k has n=4k and m≥2^(k+1), so 2^n≤m⁴. Brute force is already polynomial in encoded size, and peak 8 is not superpolynomial evidence. Self-dual majority has the same defect. The informative regime is m=2^o(n). Proposed stress: read-once dual pairs. L4: h_i=x_(2i−1)∧x_(2i), g_j=h_(2j−1)∨h_(2j), f=(g_1∧g_2)∨(g_3∧g_4). P is the 64 positive 4-clauses taking one leaf from each h under g_j and g_j', j∈{1,2}, j'∈{3,4}. N is the 8 negative 4-clauses h∪h' with one h under each g of one side. That is 16 variables and 72 clauses. L5 is two disjoint copies conjoined: 32 variables, 128 positive 4-clauses, 64 negative 8-clauses. Every block is a singleton, so compression and core must skip. I could not hand-trace the pinned peak and predict nothing for it.

FIXTURE (pinned v5). Self-dual majority on 9 variables: every 5-subset once positive and once negative, 252 clauses. Predicted: compression skipped with incompatible_greedy_basis (greedy picks x1⊕xj, and blocks avoiding x1 get no basis form); core no_clauses_removed; root IALH UNKNOWN with 126 windows, 4032 tuples and zero rows (each table is the weight-2 and weight-3 tuples, whose differences generate Z⁵); clause-count-nonincreasing DP then refutes with clause counts 252, 182, 112, 62, 32, 16, 8, 4, UNSAT. Peak 0.

INDEPENDENT-TEST PREDICTIONS for FK-SPLIT. On the Neon58 quotient: zero flips, δ=0, UNSAT, and node counts obey the Theorem A recurrence; a violation falsifies my rederivation. C1 (conjecture, low confidence): memoised distinct states are ≤m² on L4 and L5.
missing_theorem:
T-A (Lean target, elementary): Lemma 0, Lemma 1 and the Theorem A recurrence exactly as stated, including heredity of cross-intersection under restriction, unit propagation and subsumption, and the union-bound SAT exit.
M1 (open; equivalent to DUAL∈P): a bound polynomial in m on memoised states for all cross-intersecting split CNFs. Without it the best provable total-work bound for the natural closure of Neon58 is quasi-polynomial. Fredman–Khachiyan Algorithm B gives m^o(log m); I have not rederived it.
M2 (the theorem needed for arbitrary extras and incompatible spaces): a polynomial-time computable parameter π(F) with total work ≤ poly(m)·g(π), where π stays bounded on the residuals the pinned search actually produces. The candidates β and δ satisfy the work inequality but nothing bounds them. A uniform bound would give P=NP and is not claimed.
C1 (conjecture): read-once dual pairs L_d need polynomially many memoised states under the shortest-clause/frequency rule with a deterministic tie-break.
C2 (integration gap): interleaving pinned elim or SCC with S3 leaves the class, because resolvents and merged literals are mixed-sign. No bound is known for the mixed procedure.
self_attack:
1. No new mathematics: S3 is Fredman–Khachiyan A. The contribution is the exact classification, Lemma 1, and the reduction of the polynomial claim to a named open problem.
2. Quasi-polynomial is not polynomial. For m near 200 the proved bound is far above brute force, so only measured node counts are informative. To my knowledge no polynomial-size UNSAT certificate system for DUAL is known, so Lean replay can blow up too.
3. Neon58 itself never needed this: 2^n≤m⁴, and a pair-adjacent order already gives peak 2. FK-SPLIT is justified only by instances with m=2^o(n), and I have not exhibited one failing on v5.
4. Fragility: one mixed-sign extra clause defeats S1; one clause disjoint from many opposite clauses makes S2 exponential. Selecting a cross-intersecting UNSAT subfamily for an UNSAT-only shortcut is a biclique-type selection problem with no bound.
5. Published lower-bound constructions for dualization algorithms (Takata; Hagen; Gurvich–Khachiyan on tightness of the frequency lemma) may defeat C1. I have not checked them against the memoised variant.
6. Fixture risk: the DP counts are hand-derived from a weight-class invariant (stage r holds the 5-subset clauses plus full-width clauses forbidding weights r−4..4). An arithmetic slip would falsify the prediction, and 126 windows exceeding the 20 s budget would void it. The fixture is a brute-force-trivial control, not a growth witness.
7. Audit item (b) is a worst-case cost read from code, not a measured timing.
mechanism_signature: Parity-union-find polarity colouring, exact cross-intersection defect saturation, then Fredman–Khachiyan shortest-clause/frequency branching with a union-bound SAT exit. Work invariant: volume v=|P|·|N| of canonical states, T(v)≤T((1−1/log₂m)v)+T(v−1)+1. SAT-exact, no fresh variables, no quotient map.
delta_from_prior: 00081 (CTS) certified one implied DNF by transversal membership and conjectured polynomial states on T_k only. 00080 added definition variables, 00079 used class tables, and Fable73 contracts link-twins. New here: (1) the residual class is identified exactly as monotone duality, with a two-way reduction; (2) a published quasi-polynomial total-work bound, rederived here, replaces per-family conjectures and covers both SAT and UNSAT; (3) the polynomial goal for this class is shown equivalent to a named open problem instead of an unnamed gap; (4) T_k is shown brute-force-polynomial in encoded size, which redirects stress tests to read-once pairs L4/L5; (5) two code-level work defects: the memo key and the quartic rejected-resolution trial.
